results.question: Who's most at risk right now?
results.cypher:
MATCH (t:Team)-[n:NEAR]->(x) WHERE n.active = true
WITH t, collect({id: x.id, kind: x.kind, status: x.status, distance_m: n.distance_m, sources: n.sources, evidence_refs: n.evidence_refs}) AS near
WITH t, near, reduce(s = 0, r IN near |
  s + CASE 
    WHEN r.kind = 'hazard' AND r.status = 'active' THEN 50 
    WHEN r.kind = 'building' AND r.status = 'collapsed' THEN 30 
    WHEN r.kind = 'building' AND r.status = 'damaged' THEN 15 
    WHEN r.kind = 'building' AND r.status = 'intact' THEN 0 
    WHEN r.kind = 'road' AND r.status = 'blocked' THEN 20 
    WHEN r.kind = 'facility' AND r.status = 'full' THEN 10 
    ELSE 0 
  END) AS danger
WHERE danger > 0
RETURN t.id AS id, t.name AS name, t.status AS status, danger, near ORDER BY danger DESC LIMIT 5
results.answer: Rescue Team 4 is on_scene and currently at highest risk with a danger score of 130, primarily due to an active gas hazard located 55.4 meters away (sensor, gps) and a collapsed building 20.9 meters away (gps, drone_vision).
